notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page for Catherine Lake has only a heading, a county and an agency line, and the state-list entry has coordinates only. The Waymarking page for the site (WM199A, posted 2007, weblookout) describes a 120-foot Aermotor at the NC DFR county headquarters west of Jacksonville, and its coordinates match the record. fetch_text returns almost no text from that page, so it is not cited and a human should check it by hand. The office address on Fire Tower Road is cited for context only; no source ties the tower to that site. Build date, design and current condition still need a source, such as an NHLR or FFLA record if one exists.
